visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short-cropped brown hair, wearing circular glasses and a yellow floral sleeveless top, speaks directly to the camera. She stands in a professional clinic or office environment. In the background, there is a black lampshade on the left and framed certificates on a white shelf on the right. (2) A graphic overlay appears featuring two circular close-up images of human skin: one showing dark, brownish acne spots and the other showing reddish, inflamed spots. The woman continues to speak, using her right hand to point upwards and gesture dynamically to emphasize her points. (3) The scene shifts back to a clear view of the woman as she discusses pitted scars. She uses wide hand gestures to illustrate structural changes in the skin. The camera remains at an eye-level medium close-up, capturing her expressive facial movements and mouth articulation. (4) A video overlay displays a medical laser procedure in progress. A metallic laser handpiece is pressed against a patch of skin, emitting pulses that create a grid of tiny red points. The woman's face is still visible in the bottom portion of the frame. (5) A 2D animation illustrates the cross-section of skin layers. A yellow laser beam penetrates the surface, targeting a deep pit and breaking up the tangled purple fibers beneath. The animation uses simple colors and clear lines to represent the medical process. (6) The animation progresses to show the skin surface smoothing over time as new, organized fibers replace the old ones. Text overlays with medical terms appear briefly on the screen to support the visual explanation of skin regeneration. (7) A side-by-side comparison graphic labeled 'Before' and 'After' shows the improvement in a patient's skin texture. The 'Before' side has deep indentations, while the 'After' side is significantly smoother. The woman gestures towards the graphic with a smile. (8) The video concludes with a static white background containing the DRX logo in black. It lists a Line ID, a phone number, and two physical addresses in Chinese text characters.
